pipelineGpsMapDescription: Plots GeoJSON features on a map.
pipelineGpsBoundsFilterDescription: Keeps only the GeoJSON features with a GPS position inside the rectangle you draw on the map.
pipelineGeoJsonStyleDescription: Sets the fill color, stroke color, stroke width and opacity of every feature in the input. Each color is either a palette color or a color generated from a chosen property of the feature. The map and the GeoJSON viewer draw the features with this style. Opacity applies to both the fill and the stroke.
pipelineGeoJsonHeatmapDescription: Turns the points, lines and polygons of every input into a smooth heatmap. Each feature adds weight around its location, and the density is drawn as colored bands from blue (low) to red (high). Granularity sets the resolution of the density grid, so higher values give more detailed edges but take longer to compute. Smoothing sets how far each feature's weight spreads, so higher values give broader, softer areas. Complexity sets the number of color bands, so higher values give a finer color gradient. Intensity picks a numeric property whose value sets how strongly each feature contributes; features without a usable value contribute nothing. The map and the GeoJSON viewer draw the bands with their fill colors.
pipelineGeoJsonZipDescription: Zips the objects of input A (full data) with input B (partial data) by a shared key such as name or name_en, chosen from a dropdown of the keys both inputs have. Each A feature keeps its geometry and gains the B properties it lacks; A's values win on conflicts, and B features without a match are dropped.
pipelineGeoJsonWithinAreaDescription: Keeps the features from input B that lie entirely inside the combined area of the features in input A. With the outside switch on, keeps the rest instead, which subtracts the area from B. Points are tested directly.
pipelineGeoJsonFeaturePickerDescription: Outputs only the feature at the slider position, as a single item. The slider runs from the first feature to the last one of the input, and the output keeps the input's collection details.
pipelineShortestRouteDescription: Finds the routes from each From airport to each To airport, one search per from-to pair, cheapest first, with the airports chained (e.g. SIN > KUL), its flights as legs, and the total price. Each route uses only its From airport, its To airport, and the optional stops, which may be none, some or all, in any order, whichever gives the cheapest route. A pair with no route is left out. If a From airport is also a To airport, the route comes back to it. Routes with a flight that has no price or a different currency come after the priced ones. Flights are one-way, so routes follow their direction. The total price is set only when every flight has a price in the same currency.
pipelineShortestRouteHint: Connect flight routes, then pick the departure airports, the airports to visit, and optional stops. Add a departure airport to the To airports to make a round trip.
pipelineShortestRouteRoundTripHint: Add at least one stop to make a round trip.
pipelineGeoJsonMergeDescription: Concatenates the GeoJSON collections from up to four inputs into one list.
pipelineGeoJsonSwitchDescription: Passes on input A by default. With the switch on, passes on input B instead. The unused input is ignored.
pipelineGeoJsonUnionDescription: Keeps each distinct feature found in either of the two inputs. Features match when their full content is the same.
pipelineGeoJsonIntersectionDescription: Keeps the features that appear in both inputs. Features match when their full content is the same.
pipelineGeoJsonDifferenceDescription: Keeps the features from the first input that do not appear in the second input.
pipelineGeoJsonSymmetricDifferenceDescri: Keeps the features that appear in exactly one of the two inputs.
pipelineGeoJsonJsonataDescription: Runs a JSONata query over the list of GeoJSON collections and passes the result on. The query re-runs as you type. With negate on, passes on the features the query leaves out instead.
pipelineIframeDescription: Shows a web page from an address you type in. Press Go, or Enter, to load it and Reload to load it again. Addresses without a scheme are opened as https. Only http and https addresses are allowed. Some sites refuse to be shown in a frame. The node warns when a page does not load in time or when the browser blocks it as mixed content, and offers to open it in a new tab. It has no inputs or outputs.
pipelinePostItDescription: A free-form sticky note for comments. The text shrinks as you type more. It does not take part in the pipeline.
pipelineGeoJsonChartDescription: Draws a line chart of one numeric property across the features of the input, in input order. Pick the key from the dropdown, which lists only properties whose values are numbers. Features without a value leave a gap in the line.
pipelineGeoJsonViewerDescription: Plots GeoJSON features on a map and lists each collection with its city, source and feature count, with a small preview of each feature.
pipelineAskGptDescription: Lets you pick property keys from the GeoJSON features on its input. When you press Ask GPT, the selected keys of every feature are serialized as a JSON array and sent to ChatGPT in a new tab. It has no output.
pipelineGeoJsonFirstFeatureDescription: Shows the properties of the first feature in the list of GeoJSON collections in a read-only text box. It has no output.
